description: Supported {en-US, en-GB} with NO bare en source, tiebreaker en:[en-US, en-GB], and a French fallback. Every en-flavored request therefore has to be resolved heuristically among two same-language regional sources, which is the configuration in which tiebreaker order, q=0 exclusion, and wildcard fallback preference each become observable. The fallback is deliberately fr, so a wildcard returning 'the first supported locale' (en-GB in sorted order) differs from one returning the configured fallback.
